description: The article recommends that identifying weaknesses in the EGRS programme — such as undifferentiated independent tasks and teachers' gaps in content knowledge for group guided reading — should feed programme redesign.
title: Use identified programme weaknesses to inform redesign so that teachers can be further supported

description: The authors conclude that the clinical decision support tool is suitable for training medical students and can be recommended in teaching.
title: Use ESR eGUIDE in teaching radiology to train appropriate imaging test selection
